about.page.eyebrow: About Campbell Consulting Services of Tallahassee (CCST)
about.page.heroTitle: Strategic Insight. Systems Thinking. Practical Innovation.
about.page.overview:
Campbell Consulting Services of Tallahassee LLC (CCST) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) specializing in Business Analysis, Systems Engineering, IT Strategy, and modern digital transformation. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Tallahassee, Florida, CCST supports government agencies, commercial organizations, and technology teams seeking clarity, structure, and dependable execution across their most important initiatives.

We combine full life cycle systems thinking with practical, real-world consulting to help organizations modernize operations, align technology investments with strategic goals, and deliver lasting outcomes. Our capabilities span IT strategy development, requirements engineering, stakeholder engagement, agile delivery, cybersecurity support, data initiatives, and full SDLC project execution. Whether guiding a modernization effort, supporting a state or federal program, or building intelligent software solutions, CCST brings disciplined processes and a client-centered approach to every engagement.

As a trusted partner in both the public and private sectors, we pride ourselves on measurable results, transparency, and sustained impact. Our work is grounded in rigorous analysis, well-defined processes, and a deep understanding of regulatory and operational environments-including HIPAA, CMMC, and state-level compliance requirements.
about.mission.heading: Our Mission
about.mission.text: To bring clarity, structure, and disciplined execution to every initiative we support-transforming complexity into actionable insight and enabling strong, sustainable outcomes for our clients.

about.differentiators.outro: Across every service line-Strategic Decision Support, SLED Contracting, and Software Development-our mission remains the same: to help organizations transform complexity into actionable insight and position themselves for long-term success.

regent.title: Regent: runtime governance for AI agents
regent.opening: Regent is a governance layer that sits between your people and the AI they use. Every turn passes through policy enforcement before it reaches the model, and every action lands in a tamper-evident audit chain after. If an auditor, a client, or your own compliance team asks "what did the AI actually do," Regent is the system that answers with proof instead of a shrug.
regent.problem.heading: The problem it solves
regent.problem.text: AI adoption stalls on one question: can we trust what it did? Logs can be edited. Screenshots prove nothing. Most AI governance today is a policy PDF nobody can enforce and a dashboard nobody checks. Regent replaces trust-me with show-me: mechanical enforcement at runtime, and records that break visibly if anyone tampers with them.
regent.capabilities.heading: What Regent does
regent.capabilities.policy.title: Policy enforcement at runtime
regent.capabilities.policy.text: Rules are enforced on every single turn, in the request path, not reviewed after the fact. A blocked action never reaches the model.
regent.capabilities.audit.title: Tamper-evident audit chain
regent.capabilities.audit.text: Every governed turn is written to a hash-linked chain. Edit one record and verification fails at exactly that line. This is the receipt for every AI action your organization takes.
regent.capabilities.memory.title: Session governance and memory
regent.capabilities.memory.text: Working context is preserved and governed across sessions, so the AI stays consistent and the organization, not the individual seat, owns the record.
regent.audience.heading: Who it is for
regent.audience.text: Regent is built for organizations that answer to someone: MSPs answering to clients, contractors answering to agencies, regulated businesses answering to auditors. If "the AI did it" is not an acceptable incident report in your world, you are who we built this for.
regent.fit.heading: How it fits
regent.fit.text: Regent works with the AI subscriptions you already have. It does not replace your models; it governs them. Deployment is a lightweight install alongside your existing tools, currently in alpha with pilot organizations.
regent.faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
regent.faq.1.question: What is runtime AI governance?
regent.faq.1.answer: Runtime AI governance means enforcing rules while the AI is working, on every request, instead of auditing after something has gone wrong. It is the difference between a guardrail and an incident report.
regent.faq.2.question: What is a tamper-evident audit trail for AI?
regent.faq.2.answer: A record of AI activity where every entry is cryptographically linked to the one before it. If any entry is altered, verification fails and shows exactly where. Ordinary logs cannot make that promise.
regent.faq.3.question: Does Regent work with ChatGPT and Claude?
regent.faq.3.answer: Yes. Regent governs the connection between your users and major AI providers, including OpenAI and Anthropic models, using your existing subscriptions.
regent.faq.4.question: Is Regent available today?
regent.faq.4.answer: Regent is in alpha with pilot organizations. Book an intro call to talk about a pilot.
